connect.apiBody: Two ways to connect a site to the rikma — everything it sells lands here automatically.
connect.donationHint: A donation is recorded as a sale and goes into the split like any income.
connect.starterTitle: A ready shop for your site
connect.starterBody: Catalog, variant picker, cart and payment with Stripe, PayPal or by arrangement over the phone — connected to the rikma. Deploy to Vercel or Netlify in one click, and every order lands here with its shipping details.
connect.starterEnvHint: The deploy asks for two values from the rikma — both are here:
connect.starterReplaceConfirm: The current key stops working right away, and a shop already using it will need the new one. Continue?
connect.starterSaveWarning: Copy the key now — it is shown only once. If you lose it, just create a new one.
connect.starterKeyScopes: The key gets only orders:create and orders:read, and lives only on the shop’s server (an environment variable) — never in the browser.
connect.starterKeyError: Creating the key failed. Please try again.
connect.starterDeployHint: The rikma address is already filled in on the Vercel or Netlify form. Create a key in step 1 and click here right after — the key gets filled in too. All that’s left is the details of the payment provider you chose.
connect.siteTitle: Already have a site? Report sales
connect.siteBody: A snippet your existing site sends after each checkout — one sale per payment. The key made here only reports sales and does not fit the ready-made shop.
connect.otherKeys: Need a key with other permissions (tasks, catalog)? All keys and permissions —
connect.starterDeployReady: The rikma address and the key will be filled in on the Vercel or Netlify form — all that’s left is the details of the payment provider you chose.
connect.payArrangedHint: The buyer orders and leaves a name and phone number, with no payment on the site. The order waits in the "Awaiting payment" tab, you arrange the money with them, then tap "Payment received". The deploy form also asks for the shop’s WhatsApp number (972…) — for the button on the thank-you page. A shop works this way with no Stripe or PayPal at all.

ww.openNote: A sale still waiting for its holder's consent stays out of the split until it is approved.
ww.pendingTitle: A split proposal was sent and is being approved
ww.silence: If nobody responds, the proposal is approved by silence when the rikma's response time ends.
ww.ssSub: 1💗1 joins the split as a service-providing partner. This amount is deducted from the profit shared between partners (left to split: {{left}} of {{total}}). Suggested: {{proposed}} - you may give more or ask for less; approved instantly.

pay.body: Whoever confirms here holds the money: the sales are recorded in your name. If the buyer paid another partner, ask them to confirm.
pay.amountHint: Gave a discount on the phone? Enter what actually arrived.
pay.under: Less than the catalog price ({{amount}}) — the order will be marked as sold at a discount.
pay.confirm: Yes, the money is with me
pay.failed: The payment didn't save. Try again.

fulfil.intro: What happens once an order is paid: each step opens a task for whoever holds the mission or role, inside the work that is already theirs. Steps never touch value or shares.
fulfil.introConsent: A step that lands on someone else waits for their yes. A step you set for yourself is live at once.
fulfil.notReady: Automation is not available here yet
fulfil.notReadyBody: The shop server update has to be deployed first. Orders keep working as usual.
fulfil.emptyBody: For example: "every order with delivery opens a shipping task for the courier".
fulfil.editAsksAgain: Changing a step asks again for the consent of whoever it lands on.
fulfil.askYou: This step will open tasks for you. Nothing opens until you agree — you can also suggest a change.
fulfil.removed: Step removed; tasks it already opened stay
fulfil.error: Something went wrong, please try again

effect.none: When done: the order is unchanged

state.noTarget: Nobody it lands on right now

f.name: Step name
f.noMissions: No running mission in the rikma has a holder

f.zonesSome: Only orders shipped to the selected zones.

ship.intro: How products reach buyers: delivery zones with a price for each method, pickup points, and rules for special products. The rikma's site prices delivery for every cart and address from this, and 1lev1 checks it again when the order is recorded.
ship.notReady: Shipping settings are not available here yet
ship.notReadyBody: The shop's server update needs to be deployed. Until then every product keeps its own delivery options.
ship.enabledOn: On — the site offers the buyer the methods that fit their address.
ship.enabledOff: Off — the site keeps each product's own delivery options.
ship.handlingHint: Working days (Sun–Thu) between the order and the parcel leaving.
ship.fallback: For an address no zone covers, offer "we'll be in touch" instead of blocking the order
ship.zonesHint: The first zone in the list that fits the address decides. Put a narrow zone (a city) above a wide one (the whole country).
ship.zonesEmptyBody: For example: "Tel Aviv area — courier ₪30, free over ₪300" and below it "Rest of Israel — registered mail ₪45".
ship.daysHint: None selected — goes out any day.
ship.tiersHint_subtotal: The highest tier the total reaches replaces the price.
ship.tiersHint_weight: The highest tier the weight reaches replaces the price.
ship.notePh: e.g. The courier calls before arriving
ship.whoDelivers: Who sends the parcels for this zone? A rule that opens a task for the courier —
ship.pickupHint: Pickup does not depend on the address: the buyer always sees it when every product in the cart allows pickup.
ship.productsHint: A product that is not shipped (pickup only), a digital product, or a bulky one that adds to the delivery price. The extra stays even when delivery is free.
ship.preview: Check: what would a buyer see?
ship.previewOff: Pricing is off — buyers do not see this yet.
ship.previewNeedsAddress: Pick a locality to see the delivery methods.
ship.problems: Some things need finishing before saving
